threats.threatDescription: Response tampering: Attacker modifies response data before it reaches VPN Gateway

threats.threatDescription: Receiver repudiation: Remote Support denies receiving or processing the request

threats.causeDescription: No delivery confirmation or cryptographic receipt — VPN Gateway has no proof that Remote Support received its data

threats.threatDescription: Eavesdropping on response: Attacker intercepts sensitive response data from Remote Support

threats.causeDescription: Unencrypted or weakly protected response channel — response data is readable in transit

threats.threatDescription: Response blocking: Attacker prevents VPN Gateway from receiving responses from Remote Support

threats.causeDescription: No redundancy or timeout protection — VPN Gateway depends on responses from Remote Support to continue operation

threats.causeDescription: VPN Gateway trusts response data from Remote Support without integrity verification, enabling privilege decisions based on forged responses

threats.causeDescription: Missing sender authentication on incoming data flow — Remote Support cannot verify the true origin of received data

TITLE: ISO 21434

[FREETEXT]
**ISO/SAE 21434** is the international standard for cybersecurity engineering in road vehicles. It defines requirements throughout the vehicle lifecycle from concept to decommissioning.

Core elements include:

- Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment (TARA) methodology
- Cybersecurity goals and requirements derivation
- Verification and validation of cybersecurity measures
- Continuous cybersecurity monitoring and response

This threat model follows the ISO 21434 TARA methodology, systematically identifying threat scenarios, assessing attack feasibility, determining impact ratings, and deriving appropriate cybersecurity goals and requirements.
